# Browser
## Stop: choose the right surface before any browser action
Explicit browser intent wins: if the user names the in-app browser or Chrome, or asks to open, show, or navigate to a page; inspect its visual or interactive state; or interact with its UI, continue with Browser and do not substitute a connector.

Otherwise, treat a URL or open browser tab as context, not browser intent. Earlier Browser use does not make later semantic work browser-first. Before each semantic operation on a linked resource, you MUST query available and deferred tools for an applicable connector, API, or CLI. Reading this skill or scanning visible tools does not count. Do not initialize Browser for that operation until the query is complete. Use the non-browser tool when available. If it handles the current operation, continue the larger workflow without Browser for that operation. Use Browser when no such tool exists, the tool cannot access the resource or lacks a required capability, or UI work remains; use available browser context before asking the user to repeat it.

Use this skill for browser automation tasks such as inspecting pages, navigating, testing local apps, clicking, typing, taking screenshots, and reading visible page state.

If this plugin is listed as available in the session, treat that as mandatory reading before browser work. Open and follow this skill before saying that Browser is unavailable and before falling back to standalone Playwright or Computer Use.

Do not skip this skill just because Computer Use MCP tool calls are directly visible or appear easier to invoke. The presence of Computer Use tools is not evidence that Computer Use is the preferred browser surface.

If setup or recovery is needed, describe it naturally as connecting to the browser or retrying the browser connection.

The `browser-client` module is the core entry point for browser use, and is available under `scripts/browser-client.mjs` in this plugin's root directory. ALWAYS import it using an absolute path. IMPORTANT: If this path cannot be found, stop and report that this plugin is missing `scripts/browser-client.mjs`. NEVER use the built in `browser-client` library.

CODE MODE REQUIREMENT: When you call the Node REPL `js` tool from the code-mode `exec` tool, the outer `exec` script containing the initial `documentation()` call MUST begin with `// @exec: {"max_output_tokens": 20000}`. if (globalThis.agent?.browsers == null) {
  const { setupBrowserRuntime } = await import("<plugin root>/scripts/browser-client.mjs");

A tab binding is separate from its browser binding. ```

If the user explicitly requests Chrome or Edge but that family is unavailable,

An explicit browser choice remains in force for the task. If authentication blocks the task in an explicitly selected browser, your next response must explicitly ask the user to sign in in that browser and tell you when it is ready, unless that browser's documentation provides a supported authentication flow to try first. Merely reporting that sign-in is required is not sufficient. Do not switch to another browser unless the user asks or approves the switch.

### The user explicitly requests an external browser without naming a family
When the user says to use their external browser, browser extension, or a
similar external-browser surface without naming Chrome or Edge, select the
first connected extension instance directly. Do not call
`agent.browsers.list()` first:

```js

```

If no extension instance is available, tell the user that their external
browser needs the ChatGPT browser extension and direct them to

browser.

### The task requires browser interaction, the user does not specify a browser, and the task has a target URL
When the user supplies a URL or the intended URL can be reasonably inferred from the request, replace the example below with that URL and let browser-client choose the browser best suited to it. Do not call `agent.browsers.list()` first:

```

If setup succeeds but browser discovery or selection fails, read `await agent.documentation.get("bootstrap-troubleshooting")` before resetting the JavaScript session or trying another browser-control mechanism.

# VFX Reference Dossier — teleport

## Candidate 1: Automaton Lightning Warp Effect (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Automaton Lightning Warp Effect
- primary_url: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hLUuMGm4sHM](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hLUuMGm4sHM)
- secondary_urls: [https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/AutomatonLightningWarpEffect](https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/AutomatonLightningWarpEffect)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The delayed charge clearly establishes the destination before the character disappears and resolves in paired departure/arrival bursts. It is an unusually complete reference for telegraphing blink_translate without depicting ordinary traversal.
- readability_notes: Bright geometric markers and high-contrast mechanical lightning remain readable at the native isometric camera. The source and destination beats are visually distinct even against environmental detail.

## Candidate 2: Stygian Flame Dash Effect (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Stygian Flame Dash Effect
- primary_url: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PykOVssTmTo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PykOVssTmTo)
- secondary_urls: [https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/StygianFlameDashEffect](https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/StygianFlameDashEffect)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: A short ignition collapses the character into a dark-blue blink, while a directional residue connects departure and arrival without implying continuous bodily travel. The arrival flare and lingering ground treatment give the translation a firm endpoint.
- readability_notes: The saturated blue-white core reads well against PoE’s dark terrain. Its narrow trail preserves directionality without covering a large combat footprint.

## Candidate 3: Shadow Strike with Nightfall (Grim Dawn)
- source_game: Grim Dawn
- skill_or_mtx_name: Shadow Strike + Nightfall
- primary_url: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uODooeXJGdE](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uODooeXJGdE)
- secondary_urls: [https://grimdawn.fandom.com/wiki/Shadow_Strike_%28Skill%29](https://grimdawn.fandom.com/wiki/Shadow_Strike_%28Skill%29)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=N; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The character seemingly vanishes and reappears over a targeted victim, followed by a weapon strike and Nightfall’s radial payload. It is a strong combat-teleport reference because repositioning and offensive impact resolve as one motion.
- readability_notes: The rapid approach is subtle, but the target lock, dark motion streak, and circular impact make the endpoint clear. Nightfall materially improves readability in enemy clusters.

## Candidate 4: Teleport — Lightning Sorceress showcase (Diablo II: Resurrected)
- source_game: Diablo II: Resurrected
- skill_or_mtx_name: Teleport
- primary_url: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YaUOt4_zxjs](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YaUOt4_zxjs)
- secondary_urls: [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/23719810/diablo-ii-resurrected-class-guide-showcase-ft-dbrunski125](https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/23719810/diablo-ii-resurrected-class-guide-showcase-ft-dbrunski125)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: This is the canonical minimal blink_translate treatment: a compact casting gesture, instantaneous spatial discontinuity, and a restrained arrival flash. Repeated gameplay casts show how the effect behaves during rapid traversal rather than only in an isolated beauty shot.
- readability_notes: The silhouette disappearance and bright arrival cue remain legible at the classic isometric camera. High-speed cast chains are useful for persistence testing, although individual cycles may require frame stepping.

## Search log
- Searched official Path of Exile MTX pages, official Path of Exile YouTube showcases, and announcement posts for Lightning Warp, Flame Dash, Frostblink, Dash, and Blink Arrow effects.
- Verified isolated official videos for Automaton Lightning Warp and Stygian Flame Dash; also found Myrmidon Dash, but excluded it because its visible continuous dash is a weaker match for blink_translate.
- Searched Diablo III’s official game guide for Teleport and rune-effect footage; current indexed results exposed item, profile, and build pages but no strong dedicated official video, so none was included.
- Searched Blizzard’s Diablo II: Resurrected class showcases and verified the Lightning Sorceress gameplay video embedded by Blizzard.
- Searched the official Grim Dawn wiki, Crate forums, and skill-overview videos; Shadow Strike + Nightfall produced the strongest targeted-impact teleport reference.
- Searched Last Epoch support/media and Lost Ark official media. Last Epoch’s official documentation verifies Teleport, but no clean isolated official video surfaced; Lost Ark searches did not produce a clearly matching, verifiable showcase.
